name: scientific_visualization
description: Scientific visualization is a cross-domain visualization primitive for truthful, accessible, publication-ready figures. Use it for figure design, multi-panel layouts, uncertainty and missing-data displays, color and contrast review, image metadata validation, and export planning.
capabilities: Choose visual encodings that preserve scientific meaning.
Plan uncertainty, missing data, transformations, and accessibility cues.
Specify Matplotlib, Seaborn, Plotly, raster, vector, and journal export constraints.
requirements: Source data or image provenance and transformation notes.
Target medium and export requirements when known.
Appropriate plotting or export tooling for execution.
